subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add core Control UI save-time MEMORY.md budget enforcement now, and should auto-archive be part of that same scope?
rationale: Current main already provides prompt, doctor, and /context diagnostics, while the remaining request changes editor behavior and persistent memory lifecycle rather than repairing a single broken code path.

options.title: Add narrow editor guardrail
options.body: Implement a Control UI budget meter plus save-time warning/blocking for bootstrap files, and track auto-archive separately.

options.title: Fold into bounded memory design
options.body: Move hard limits and archive behavior under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42877 and treat this issue as a UI visibility subset.

options.title: Diagnostics only
options.body: Keep the existing prompt, doctor, and /context diagnostics as the supported behavior and close or narrow this request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Add narrow editor guardrail
recommendation.body: Implement a Control UI budget meter plus save-time warning/blocking for bootstrap files, and track auto-archive separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is ownership of the bootstrap warning and diagnostics surfaces that the Control UI guardrail would extend.
